findings.section: Task2 final bullet and Task3 first two bullets
findings.issue: The plan obtains exact-stage admission against a prospective master tree before the fast-forward, then seals actual master immediately before the run without explicitly requiring independent acceptance of that final seal. This leaves the actual execution's final refs/source/command evidence outside the stated admission gate.
findings.required_change: Distinguish pre-fast-forward commit/application readiness review from launch admission. After local master fast-forward, freeze actual master refs, actual loaded source/test paths and bytes, runtime, command, deadline, guards and output reservation, then obtain fresh independent exact-stage acceptance of that final seal before launching. Require the same final-seal admission for the 600-second pure-timeout attempt. Preserve this original plan and review.

production_assessment: Whole candidate source review has found no unnecessary new production solve-loop work or retained owner; remaining independent stored-data/source checks are in progress. No runtime or production change was made.
